I will complete the step today and keep the confirmation for follow-up reference number 13.

Jordan Lee: I scanned the form after our meeting. Could the bottom of the page have been cut off when I uploaded it? Jordan Lee: I also noticed a small late-registration charge. Will that disappear once the warning is removed?

Jordan Lee: Will I lose my seat in the environmental science seminar while the new form is being reviewed? Jordan Lee: So my two steps are to upload the full page and send you the new confirmation number before Friday.

Ms. Rivera: No. I can place a temporary note on your account today, and the seat will remain reserved through Friday afternoon. Ms. Rivera: Exactly. Keep the email receipt, and contact me again only if the account still shows a warning tomorrow.
